Official Artist Claim & Chain-of-Custody Verification

DSP Identity & Copyright Verification: The Stardust Engine

Notice to Platform Verification Teams (DistroKid, Apple Music for Artists, Spotify for Artists, Amazon Music, YouTube Music): This official portal confirms that Michael P. Ragsdale (dsp.operations@engineroom-records.com • Official US ISRC Agency Registrant ID 185611, Allocated Prefix QTAHP) is the sole real-world human creator, songwriter, producer, copyright owner, and authorized claimant for The Stardust Engine (271 registered sound recordings under the Engine Room Records imprint at engineroom-records.com).

🛡️ Dual Timelines Policy (In-Universe Lore Dates vs. Real-World 2026 Production Dates)

The Stardust Engine is a multimedia Rock Opera concept project set between 1986 and 2016. Historical years in album URLs and lore descriptions (such as 2001 for Midnight Drivers and 2011 for Starfield Calibration) represent fictional In-Universe Narrative Lore Eras (schema:temporalCoverage). 100% of all sound recordings, lyrics, vocal melodies, and studio masters were created and produced in 2026 (schema:datePublished: 2026) by Michael P. Ragsdale (dsp.operations@engineroom-records.com) under commercial license, with zero third-party samples or stems.

First-Party Remaster Chain of Custody • DistroKid Ref: Z0MB5RT4

Chain-of-Custody Verification: “The Horizon Line” (2001 Lore Original & 2011 Lore Remaster)

1. Original Release (May 1, 2026): Michael P. Ragsdale released his original song “The Horizon Line” on Midnight Drivers (Catalog ID ERR-001-2001-105, DistroKid ISRC QZWFW2601360, Album UPC 825324114857) via DistroKid on 2026-05-01.
2. Independent Third-Party Release (June 23, 2026): Fifty-three days later, on 2026-06-23, third-party artist coffeeandpop released a 100% independent Suno AI generation titled “Horizon Line” (UPC 882518230267) that shares only the common title and Suno’s synthesized female vocal model.
3. First-Party Remaster (October 17, 2026): Track 13 of Starfield Calibration (“The Horizon Line [Cosmic Tidal Lock Mix]”, Catalog ID ERR-001-2011-113, Album UPC 700299965607, uploaded 2026-10-17) is a 100% first-party studio remaster of Michael P. Ragsdale’s own May 1, 2026 song (ISRC: QZWFW2601360). Neither artist sampled or copied from the other.

The Stardust Engine (ERR-001)

Named after the very first song Ryan, Cassidy, Evan, and Tyler wrote together at CPI in 1986—celebrating their shared love of the cosmos (“Stardust”) and the rockets to get you there (“Engine”).
